## Website Plans & Transparent INR Pricing

### Plan 01: Anchor — ₹15,000 (negotiable) · 3 days
- Scope: Website only (clean responsive build, contact form, domain & hosting setup, 1 month free maintenance).
- Payment split: ₹2,500 lock-in deposit / ₹6,250 after live demo / ₹6,250 on final delivery.

### Plan 02: Beacon (Recommended) — ₹25,000 · 5 days
- Scope: Website + Google SEO foundation (keyword research, meta titles/descriptions, alt text, speed optimization, XML sitemap, robots.txt, Google Search Console & Analytics, structured schema data, first month of SEO + 1 month free maintenance).
- Payment split: ₹2,500 lock-in deposit / ₹11,250 after live demo / ₹11,250 on final delivery.

### Plan 03: Pulse — ₹60,000 · 7 days
- Scope: Everything in Beacon plus bespoke scroll motion graphics, page transitions, animated visuals, AEO (answer-first FAQ blocks + FAQPage schema), and GEO (structured citations for ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity).
- Payment split: ₹2,500 lock-in deposit / ₹28,750 after live demo / ₹28,750 on final delivery.

### Plan 04: Atlas — ₹90,000 · Scoped by workload
- Scope: Everything in Pulse plus a complete online store (product catalogue, categories, shopping cart, Razorpay checkout, admin panel for products/stock/orders, shipping & tax rules, 1 month free maintenance).
- Payment split: ₹2,500 lock-in deposit / ₹43,750 after live demo / ₹43,750 on final delivery.

## Extras & Optional Post-Month-1 Renewals
- Extra pages: ₹1,500 per page (Atlas product pages are included).

- SEO + GEO + maintenance: ₹15,000/month (+₹2,500/month surcharge for Atlas stores).
- SEO + GEO + AEO + maintenance: ₹22,000/month (+₹2,500/month surcharge for Atlas stores).

## Core Terms
